home.robot_first: Crypto Fund Trader provides participants with exclusive access to proprietary platforms designed for trading in a simulated environment. These platforms allow users to test their strategies with market-like conditions—now including an exclusive integration with Bybit demo environment, one of the world’s most recognized crypto trading platforms. Our tools enable you to track and manage your simulated trading performance with ultra-low simulated spreads and competitive virtual commissions. We also offer compatibility with MetaTrader 5, the most widely used platform in retail trading education.
home.robot_second: We offer performance-based incentives to participants who excel in our evaluation programs. These rewards are determined exclusively by our internal criteria and based on trading performance within a simulated environment. The structure of these incentives is designed to recognize participant achievement. Incentives may vary depending on performance metrics, and are granted solely at the discretion of Crypto Fund Trader.These incentives do not derive from real market profits, and the simulated trading environment does not involve financial exposure or access to actual funds.
